To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) 3D human poses estimated from a single image can be improved by using a 3D pose prior and that (2) a 2D-3D integrated approach for 3D pose estimation outperforms both 3D and 2D approaches on both 2D and the challenging 3D pose task.
We propose a unified framework for 2D and3D human pose recovery from a single image.

3D pose information improves 2D pose estimation; 2D pose information improves the 3D pose estimation; a multi-stage network is more effective than a single stage; and, the proposed method is significantly more efficient than previous state-of-the-art approaches.
